def extract_errors(lines):
    # TODO: find ERROR or FATAL as whole tokens, ignoring case
    pass

testCases.name: mixed-case severity tokens
testCases.code: assert extract_errors(['INFO: start', 'UVM_ERROR: mismatch', 'fatal: timeout']) == ['UVM_ERROR: mismatch', 'fatal: timeout']

testCases.name: avoid partial-token matches
testCases.code: assert extract_errors(['ERROR_COUNT=0', 'NO_ERROR found', 'ERROR: real failure']) == ['ERROR: real failure']

solution:
import re

def extract_errors(lines):
    pattern = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(?:UVM_)?(?:ERROR|FATAL)\b', re.IGNORECASE)
    return [line for line in lines if pattern.search(line)]

solution:
import random

def generate_vectors(seed, count, width):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    limit = 1 << width
    return [rng.randrange(limit) for _ in range(count)]

title: Interpret a Simulation Command Result
description: Classify a simulation run using its process return code and transcript.
task: Implement classify_simulation_result(return_code, stdout, stderr). Return 'PASS' only when return_code is 0, stdout contains the exact token 'TEST_PASS', and neither stdout nor stderr contains the exact token 'TEST_FAIL'. Otherwise return 'FAIL'. Tokens are case-sensitive and must not match as part of a longer alphanumeric/underscore token.
constraints: Use token-aware matching rather than a substring-only check.
This exercise interprets a supplied process result; the browser runner cannot launch native simulator processes.
starterCode:
import re

def classify_simulation_result(return_code, stdout, stderr):
    # TODO: inspect the exit code and result tokens
    pass
solution:
import re

def classify_simulation_result(return_code, stdout, stderr):
    pass_token = re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])TEST_PASS(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', stdout) is not None
    fail_pattern = r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])TEST_FAIL(?![A-Za-z0-9_])'
    fail_token = re.search(fail_pattern, stdout) or re.search(fail_pattern, stderr)
    return 'PASS' if return_code == 0 and pass_token and not fail_token else 'FAIL'

title: Find Failed Regression Seeds
description: Identify which randomized seeds should be rerun after a regression.
task: Implement failed_seeds(results). results maps integer seed values to status strings. Return the seeds whose status is exactly 'FAIL', sorted in ascending order. Ignore other statuses such as 'PASS' and 'SKIP'.
constraints: Do not mutate results.
Return an empty list when no seed failed.
solution:
def failed_seeds(results):
    return sorted(seed for seed, status in results.items() if status == 'FAIL')

title: Generate a Regression Summary Report
description: Turn aggregate regression metrics into a consistent human-readable report.
task: Implement format_report(summary). Return exactly four newline-separated lines in this format: 'Regression summary', 'Logs: N', 'Passed: N', and 'Failed: N', using the values in summary under keys logs, passed, and failed.
constraints: Return a string, not a list.
Do not add a trailing newline.
solution:
def format_report(summary):
    return (f"Regression summary\n"
            f"Logs: {summary['logs']}\n"
            f"Passed: {summary['passed']}\n"
            f"Failed: {summary['failed']}")
